import math
from gurobipy import *

def solve_problem():
    m = Model("Facility_Location")
    m.setParam("TimeLimit", 300)

    # Problem Data
    facilities = list(range(13))  # F0..F12
    customers = list(range(43))  # C0..C42

    # Facility coordinates (x, y)
    facility_coords = [(81, 74), (48, 82), (26, 2), (45, 21), (62, 84), (0, 19), (90, 82), (12, 78), (78, 97), (79, 34), (33, 51), (69, 3), (56, 9)]

    # Customer coordinates (x, y)
    customer_coords = [(41, 84), (97, 30), (43, 76), (98, 98), (59, 39), (10, 39), (5, 65), (94, 82), (79, 36), (4, 94), (7, 7), (82, 30), (7, 11), (8, 60), (42, 31), (34, 45), (82, 98), (31, 85), (39, 34), (28, 7), (14, 24), (39, 42), (75, 49), (14, 76), (47, 56), (97, 55), (36, 70), (63, 16), (84, 27), (10, 74), (78, 97), (73, 76), (92, 86), (9, 37), (42, 12), (32, 61), (19, 40), (86, 91), (12, 59), (26, 65), (78, 46), (23, 40), (56, 51)]

    facility_capacities = [182.0, 141.0, 174.0, 138.0, 117.0, 114.0, 144.0, 158.0, 198.0, 186.0, 141.0, 191.0, 181.0]
    customer_demands = [33.0, 45.0, 40.0, 41.0, 49.0, 13.0, 44.0, 11.0, 41.0, 24.0, 38.0, 46.0, 39.0, 27.0, 32.0, 35.0, 17.0, 12.0, 31.0, 31.0, 20.0, 19.0, 33.0, 12.0, 13.0, 37.0, 37.0, 24.0, 41.0, 40.0, 19.0, 45.0, 10.0, 29.0, 28.0, 20.0, 40.0, 31.0, 22.0, 45.0, 16.0, 31.0, 40.0]
    fixed_costs = [256.0, 334.0, 187.0, 417.0, 460.0, 488.0, 413.0, 130.0, 322.0, 321.0, 428.0, 248.0, 307.0]
    transport_rate = 0.5  # $/km/unit

    # COMPUTE distance matrix from coordinates (INDUCED COSTS)
    def euclidean_distance(coord1, coord2):
        return math.sqrt((coord1[0] - coord2[0])**2 + (coord1[1] - coord2[1])**2)

    distances = {}
    for i in facilities:
        for j in customers:
            distances[(i, j)] = euclidean_distance(facility_coords[i], customer_coords[j])

    # Decision Variables
    # Open_F{i}: Binary - whether facility i is opened
    open_facility = {}
    for i in facilities:
        open_facility[i] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.BINARY, name=f"Open_F{i}")

    # Ship_F{i}_C{j}: Continuous - units shipped from facility i to customer j
    ship = {}
    for i in facilities:
        for j in customers:
            ship[(i, j)] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Ship_F{i}_C{j}")

    # Objective: Minimize fixed costs + transport costs
    # Transport cost = distance * rate * units shipped
    obj = quicksum(fixed_costs[i] * open_facility[i] for i in facilities)
    obj += quicksum(
        distances[(i, j)] * transport_rate * ship[(i, j)]
        for i in facilities for j in customers
    )
    m.setObjective(obj, GRB.MINIMIZE)

    # Demand satisfaction constraints
    for j in customers:
        m.addConstr(
            quicksum(ship[(i, j)] for i in facilities) >= customer_demands[j],
            name=f"Demand_C{j}"
        )

    # Capacity constraints (can only ship if facility is open)
    for i in facilities:
        m.addConstr(
            quicksum(ship[(i, j)] for j in customers) <= facility_capacities[i] * open_facility[i],
            name=f"Capacity_F{i}"
        )

    m.optimize()
    return m
